scope: Exact CLI format admission for diagnostics and launch evidence; no new provider requests, account changes, product capability or efficiency acceptance.

claude.parserEvidence: Actual CLI local fake provider: 30 responses across two same-session arms, official parseClaudeStreamRound and claudeTranscriptRound reconciled input/cache/output by response ID with no gaps. The private runner imports current maintained parser directly.
claude.memory: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 on each launch; strict MCP and project,local settings isolation still required.

opencode.parserEvidence: P150 original audit maps all 118 upstream raw responses to persisted assistant and step-finish usage. Current maintained parseOpenCodeRunRound replayed all retained step-finish parts read-only, restoring part id and sessionID from DB columns (DB data omits identity columns). No parser changes.
opencode.semantics: Input includes uncached input plus cache read/write; output includes separate reasoning. Each parsed response ID and token tuple matches its persisted step-finish part. P150 is a private native-text prototype; this admits observable format, not that prototype as a formal product implementation.

tests.red: New OpenCode current-version launch test failed Unregistered CLI version before exact admission. Claude separate TDD performed by driver agent.
